set.body:
Parent epic: bd-01KY1BVCQVAYT48NJEGR7M2CP6

Add beta-free RSA by deriving fold-local representational geometry directly from TrialReadout or prepared runwise operators/sufficient statistics, without a required trial-by-feature beta artifact. Specify the estimand separately for crossvalidated distances, model-RDM scoring, and nuisance partialling; reuse existing MVPA RDM/RSA result surfaces and feature-set traversal. Preserve temporal nuisance in readout/preparation and trial/model nuisance in the RSA objective. Acceptance requires equivalence to an explicit-beta oracle on the same data, crossnobis/null laws where applicable, fold leakage tests, bounded-allocation evidence, and JVM/Scala.js parity.
set.title: One-shot MVPA: beta-free RSA from runwise operators
